L’intervention des cordistes est interdite et nécessite l’utilisation d’une nacelle automotrice pilotée par des personnels certifiés munis de moyens de protection individuelle normalisés. (Voir article “ Etablissement des Plans de prévention des risques”) La méthode de pose est la s

isée suivant les mesures de prévention indiqué au plan de prévention, à l’écart de la circulation du public. La pose de filets de protection n’est pas nécessaire. La circulation de la nacelle sur Piazza se fait par la voie de circulation dite « Pompier ». 2.2.2.3- - Dépose/Pose des bâches (B) de la BO.3a et BO.3b : Même caractéristique que la méthode de dépose /pose (article 2.2.2.1) Ces bâches sont fixées sur une structure existante composée de quatre câbles gainés fixés sur une structure métallique rigide. En l’état actuel, le module de stockage est positionné à proximité de la chenille. Il est nécessaire de formuler la demande de déplacement du module de lavage 8 jours ouvrables avant la date d’intervention, au responsable du marché. La bâche BO.3 se fixe depuis une nacelle de 60 m stationnée sur la Piazza Pompidou, dans une zone à baliser et à surveiller strictement. La pose d’un filet de protection ou replis de la bâche existante est indispensable sur la chenille en verre pour protection. La mise en place d’une signalétique de coupure et la pose de rubans pour la fermeture des escaliers mécaniques entre le N1 et N4 au début de l’opération pour prévention est également indispensable. 2.2.2.4- - Dépose/Pose des bâches (B) de la BE.1/2/3) : Ces bâches sont fixées sur une

insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. When preparing a competitive quotation, vendors should take into consideration benefits provided through the national healthcare system. Quotations should refrain from over customization, and should be “off the shelf”, “commercially available”, or “market ready” products which are designed to be complementary and supplement to the national system in Portugal. The benefit levels listed from section C.1.1 through C.1.24 are a standard package that must be provided. C.1.1 Eligibility: To be eligible to participate in the medical plan, LE Staff (both full time and part time) must be: -- Paid under the terms of the Local Compensation Plan (LCP); and – -- Under a non-temporary direct hire appointment, personal services agreement (PSA), or personal services contract (PSC); or -- Under a temporary direct hire appointment or PSA Fixed Term of one year or more. Not eligible are those working under temporary appointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor l

ents; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor licensed to do business in Portugal who provides services to other local RFP 19GE5026Q0035-0001 – LES Health Insurance Services for U.S. Embassy Lisbon Page 6 of 21 organizations as well as to the U.S. Mission; employees working on an intermittent or When Actually Employed (WAE) schedule; Peace Corps personal services contractors and Recreation Association employees. C.1.2 Riders: There are no riders under this contract. C.1.3 Periods of Ineligibility: Employees and their dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment for which premiums are not paid. Additionally, employee's dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment during which the employee was not eligible to participate. During a period of extended Leave Without Pay (LWOP) or other unpaid leave beyond one pay period, the employee is responsible for the full cost of the insurance premiums for self and dependents. The Mission will pay the premiums directly to the Contractor and will collect the full cost from the employee on a quarterly basis. Alternatively

Applicability of Laws and Statutes: The procurement authority for AOC is established by statute codified at 2 U.S.C. § 1801 et seq. For procurements of $100,000 or less ("small purchases"), the AOC uses small purchase procedures implemented through policy signed by the Architect. Procurements exceeding $5,000 up to $100,000 are normally provided by small businesses utilizing the AOC small business set-aside program i

Georgia

Project Name: The Relief and Recovery for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs)

Project No: P173975

Loan No. 9239-GE

Assignment Title: Digital Transformation Expert

Reference No. GE-GEDC-CS-IC-45

Introduction

JSC Georgian Economic Development Corporation (GEDC), within the Relief and Recovery for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) Project supported by the World Bank (WB) intends to apply part of the loan proceeds for consulting services of a Digital Transformation Expert, who will operate under the World Bank MSMEs Project structure, while being functionally integrated with GEDC’s Growth Hubs network.

The Project Development Objective for the Relief and Recovery for MSME operation is to provide relief to MSMEs and support their recovery,
